build_DatasetState: build a DatasetState to track the state of a dataset including its configs, splits, and artifact states
build_FirstStepsDatasetState: build a FirstStepsDatasetState to track only the first processing steps of a dataset
build_ConfigState: build a ConfigState to track the state of a config including its splits and artifact states
build_CacheState: build a CacheState to check cache entry existence, success status, and whether it needs retry
build_JobState: build a JobState to determine if a job is currently in process based on pending jobs dataframe
